-- Test: Get basic fan info with all needed columns
SELECT 
    f.userregistry,
    f.nicklabel,
    e.socintscore,
    e.engrate,
    e.actdayswk,
    e.avgsesscount,
    m.spendusd,
    m.membdays,
    i.gifttot,
    r.churnflag
FROM fans f
JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
JOIN engagement e ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
JOIN interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON e.engagereg = r.retainengagepivot
LIMIT 3;

-- Test: Compute FEI, MV, FLV for each fan
WITH fan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry,
        f.nicklabel,
        e.socintscore,
        e.engrate,
        e.actdayswk,
        e.avgsesscount,
        m.spendusd,
        m.membdays,
        i.gifttot,
        r.churnflag
    FROM fans f
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
    JOIN engagement e ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
    JOIN interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
    JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON e.engagereg = r.retainengagepivot
),
with_fei AS (
    SELECT *,
        (engrate * 0.4) + ((socintscore / 100.0) * 0.3) + ((actdayswk / 7.0) * 0.2) + ((avgsesscount / 10.0) * 0.1) AS fei
    FROM fan_data
),
with_mv AS (
    SELECT *,
        spendusd * (1.0 + (membdays::numeric / 365.0) * 0.5) * (1.0 + (gifttot::numeric / 10.0) * 0.2) AS mv
    FROM with_fei
),
with_rrf AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE churnflag
            WHEN 'None' THEN 0
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN 'High' THEN 3
        END AS rrf
    FROM with_mv
),
with_flv AS (
    SELECT *,
        mv * (1.0 - rrf::numeric / 10.0) * (1.0 + fei) * 24 AS flv
    FROM with_rrf
)
SELECT userregistry, nicklabel, fei, mv, flv, churnflag, rrf
FROM with_flv
LIMIT 5;

WITH fan_interactions AS (
    SELECT interactfanpivot, SUM(gifttot) AS total_gifttot

fan_membership_one AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (memberfanpivot) memberfanpivot, memberreg, membdays, spendusd
